notes:
Houston 1.4.1: bug fixes.

- Users > Show processes now filters the Details page to that user.
- Suspended processes show as Suspended instead of Running.
- Ejecting the disk shown in Performance switches the view back to CPU instead of showing CPU readings as disk throughput.
- Usage history is saved on quit even when the main window is closed.
- Sampling continues while menus are open and while tables scroll.

Installation: open Houston.dmg and drag Houston to Applications. Requires Apple silicon and macOS 26 or later. This development build is ad-hoc signed and is not Developer ID notarized. Sparkle updates are signed separately with Ed25519. Existing 1.4 installs can update from Settings > Updates.

Corresponding source: Houston-Source.zip is included both as a release asset and inside the DMG. Supply it and the licenses when redistributing the app. Houston is GPL-3.0-or-later and provided without warranty.

AI disclosure: Houston was developed with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; the 1.4.1 fixes were made with Claude Code assistance. No endorsement or accuracy guarantee is implied.
